measurement_policy.inference: Predictor.predict including cleaning, encoding/vectorization, batching, model, probability and result construction; JSON and file I/O excluded
measurement_policy.load: first Predictor.from_bundle call per fresh process, including runtime imports and integrity checks; interpreter startup excluded; OS cache uncontrolled
measurement_policy.p95: nearest rank; full and tail requests reported separately
measurement_policy.throughput: total sentences / sum of measured API call times, including tail requests
measurement_policy.warmup: complete corpus passes for each batch size, excluded from measurements
